journey.name: Memory Leak Check - Profile Surface
journey.description:
Verifies that opening Edit Profile, switching profile tabs (Posts, Replies, Likes), and opening dialog overlays on the profile screen does not retain ViewModels or profile state.
Executes 3 loop iterations with theme switches (dark/light) to trigger Activity recreation while observing LeakCanary output.

actions.action: Tap the You tab on the main navigation bar
Verify that your profile screen is visible
Verify that the Edit Profile screen is visible, with Back and Save in its top app bar (full screen on phones, a dialog on tablets)
Tap the Back button in the Edit Profile top app bar
If a discard changes dialog appears, confirm Discard
Verify that your profile screen is visible
Tap the Replies tab on the profile header
Verify that reply posts list is visible
Tap the Likes tab on the profile header
Verify that liked posts list is visible
Tap the Posts tab on the profile header
Verify that own posts list is visible
Switch the device to dark theme
Switch the device back to light theme
Repeat all of the steps above two more times
Press the Home button to send the app to the background, then wait 15 seconds for LeakCanary analysis
Verify that no LeakCanary leak notification appears except for known accessibility delegate semantics cache
